studentsLoadFailed.title: Could not load the student list
studentsLoadFailed.detail: Usernames can't be matched until it loads. Close and reopen this dialog to retry.

noBatchLearners.title: No batch learners in this assessment
noBatchLearners.detail: Bulk import matches students by username from the assessment's batches. Add batches to the assessment, or enter these students one at a time.

template.title: 1. Start from a template
template.description_one: Both downloads come pre-filled with the {{count}} student in this assessment's batches, so you only fill in marks and file names.
template.description_other: Both downloads come pre-filled with the {{count}} students in this assessment's batches, so you only fill in marks and file names.

upload.title: 2. Upload the filled zip
upload.description: The zip must contain <manifest>manifest.csv</manifest> plus your scanned PDFs. PDFs in <answers>answers/</answers>, <checked>checked/</checked> or <reports>reports/</reports> named after a username are picked up automatically. No column is required — a file named after the student identifies them on its own. Nothing is saved until you review the preview.
upload.clickOrDrag: Click to upload or drag & drop

importFailed.title: Import failed
importFailed.retryNote: Your files are already uploaded — "Retry import" re-sends them without uploading again.

noRowsReady.title: No rows are ready to import
noRowsReady.detail: Every row in manifest.csv has a problem. Fix the issues listed below (or download the problems CSV) and upload the zip again.

uploadFailures.header_other: {{count}} rows were skipped because their files could not be uploaded

warnings.marksReleased: Rows with a total_marks value will have their result released to the student.
warnings.newAttempt: Importing adds a new attempt per student. To fix failures, re-upload only the affected rows — not the whole file.

ignoredColumns.hint: Check for a typo if you expected these to be read. Known columns: {{columns}}.
